records.subject: STATUS OF CONSTRUCTION OF PM MITRA PARKS
records.extent:
The Government has finalized setting up of PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel
(PM MITRA) Parks at 7 sites viz. Tamil Nadu (Virudhnagar), Telangana (Warangal), Gujarat (Navasari),
Karnataka (Kalaburagi), Madhya Pradesh (Dhar), Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow) and Maharashtra (Amravati) with
an outlay of Rs. 4445 cr for a period of seven years upto 2027-28. The PM MITRA scheme is expected to
generate employment of 3lakhs (1 lakh direct and 2 lakh indirect employment) with an estimated investment
of Rs 10,000 cr per park.

records.subject: DEVELOPMENT OF GATI SHAKTI CARGO TERMINALS IN NORTH-EASTERN REGION
records.extent:
In addition to above, In-Principle Approvals (IPAs) have been granted for the development of GCTs at 
310 more locations, including 8 locations in North-Eastern Region (comprising 7 terminals in Assam and 
1 terminal in Tripura). These projects are currently at various stages of implementation and 
commissioning.
